packageRules.description: Baseline: everything else on the gentle weekly cadence, batched by update type. Listed FIRST so the dedicated grpc/netty/quarkus groups below override it (Renovate merges packageRules in order — later rules win).
gRPC: version is pinned to the Quarkus LTS BOM (ADR NATIVE-001, Option A). Group so a maintainer reviews the bump in lockstep with the Quarkus LTS train — never automerge.
Netty: CVE-driven floor kept build-local (nettyGrpcVersion). Group so security-relevant bumps land in one reviewable PR.
Quarkus: BOM + platform + extensions move together; a bump usually implies a matching grpc/netty realignment.
